body: A generative speech model for daily dialogue.
plain_description: **Turn text into natural, expressive speech for dialogue.** Supports multiple speakers and control over pauses, laughter, and other speech details. Includes a web interface and command-line tools.
technical_description: ChatTTS is a text-to-speech model designed for dialogue scenarios, including LLM assistants. It supports English and Chinese, streaming audio generation, multiple speakers, and fine-grained prosody controls. The README shows Python installation and usage, a WebUI, and command-line inference. It states that the released model is for academic and research use.
title: ChatTTS
